fable.w: The tempting reading is that "in consultation with" and the required report signal participation. But every consulted party (the Board of Governors, the Comptroller of the Currency, the FDIC, the Secretary) is a federal entity, and the report goes to congressional committees, which are also inside the federal government. The section also concerns studies rather than a federal decision, and no outside party, public comment, hearing, rulemaking, or right to sue is involved.
fable.s: The Comptroller General of the United States, in consultation with the Board of Governors, the Comptroller of the Currency, and the Corporation, shall conduct a study

opus.w: All of the required consultation is between the Comptroller General (GAO) and other federal agencies: the Federal Reserve Board, the OCC, the FDIC and the Treasury Secretary. That makes it coordination within the federal government. The reports go only to congressional committees, which are also inside the government. No one outside the federal government is involved in any decision, so the words "in consultation with" alone do not make this participation.
opus.s: The Comptroller General of the United States, in consultation with the Board of Governors, the Comptroller of the Currency, and the Corporation, shall conduct a study of the use of hybrid capital instruments

qwen_chat.w: The consultation described is between federal entities: the Comptroller General (GAO), the Board of Governors (Federal Reserve), the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC), and the Corporation (FDIC). Since all parties involved are inside the federal government, this is intra-agency coordination, not participation with outside parties. The report is submitted to Congress, which is also inside the federal government.
qwen_chat.s: The Comptroller General of the United States, in consultation with the Board of Governors, the Comptroller of the Currency, and the Corporation, shall conduct a study
qwen_chat.b: Tempting-but-wrong reading: The section mentions "consultation" with the Board of Governors, the Comptroller of the Currency, and the Corporation. One might think this constitutes participation because it involves coordination before a decision (the study). However, all these entities (Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve, Comptroller of the Currency, Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation) are federal agencies or federal officials. Therefore, this is intra-governmental coordination, not participation with outside parties.
